items.title: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
items.summary: Long-form multi-shot video editing requires an intended edit to remain coherent across abrupt changes in scene, viewpoint, and subject appearance, while processing substantially longer visual context than conventional single-shot editors. items.summary: Psychotherapy clients may experience distress before they can coherently describe it, and their expression changes with emotion, perceived safety, and trust. items.title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
items.summary: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. items.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
items.summary: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. items.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
items.summary: Research taste, the judgment of what to read, which problems to pursue, and which methods to try, increasingly shapes the work of AI scientists, yet it remains far less understood than their ability to execute research. items.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
items.summary: General-purpose robot policies must work across robots, tasks, and environments, yet the variation that makes physical trials informative also makes them difficult to reproduce. items.summary: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. items.summary: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations by matching the teacher's token probabilities. These probabilities entangle two kinds of information: which tokens the teacher prefers, and how confident it is. items.summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. items.summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding, generation, and editing within a single unified framework. items.summary: The advancement of multimodal learning is heavily constrained by the scarcity and high annotation cost of high-quality instruction data. items.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. items.summary: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. items.summary: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. items.summary: Coding agents increasingly rely on automated approvers to decide whether a proposed shell command may run. items.summary: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. items.summary: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. items.summary: Foundation models in changing environments can encounter unfamiliar domain knowledge that their original training did not cover.
